court: In the High Court of Madras†
judges_raw: (Before Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J. and G. Arul Murugan, J.)
advocates: For Petitioner: Mr. T. Sudha Gandhi
For Respondents: Mr. Ramanlaal, Additional Advocate-General, assisted by Mr. Habeeb Rahman, Government Advocate
prayer: Prayer: Petition filed under Section 11 of the Contempt of Courts Act to punish the respondents for wilfully disobeying the orders of this Court in WP No. 2575 of 2024 dated 6-2-2024
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— When the petition was taken up for consideration, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the respondents have complied with the order passed by this Court.

2. In view of the same, nothing survives for consideration in this contempt petition. Accordingly, the contempt petition stands closed.
